verdicts.reason: The claim is true: G-1-5 and G-1-6 have no in-edges (checked), and a refugee claim can be filed by any foreigner in Korea (난민법 제5조). The proposed edges are wrong for three reasons. First, G-1-5 has only an 'extend' list in the 2026 manual (34. 기타(G-1) › 체류기간 연장허가 › 5.), so an in-Korea edge breaks the repo's edge/document invariant, and visa-docs would build no move for it. Second, G-1-5 has no gate, so every tourist would see 'Refugee applicant' as an OPEN planning option on facts the engine cannot ask. Third, choosing only 4 source statuses is arbitrary. The alternative fix, deleting the nodes, is also wrong: both are in the current-visa search list, and a reader who already holds G-1-5/G-1-6 needs them as a starting point for F-2-4 / D-2-2 / D-4-1.
verdicts.correctedFix:
Add no edges and keep both nodes. Make the decision explicit with a comment above G-1-5 in data/visamap.yaml:
  # G-1-5 and G-1-6 are start-only on purpose: a refugee claim is not a route the map
  # recommends, and the 2026 manual documents only an extension list for them. Readers who
  # already hold one pick it as their current visa.
  G-1-5:

The claim overstates the gap: B-1 has no D-8-1/D-9-1/E-1 edges, and D-2-*, D-10-1, F-2-8, F-2-12 and F-5-25 are already in-Korea. verdicts.reason: The claim holds. data/visadocs.yaml (2026.9 manual, txt 7807/7816) lists an in-Korea change to E-2 from B-1, B-2, C-3-1, C-3-4 and C-3-9 for teachers hired by the Ministry of Education or a provincial superintendent, 'whatever their current status'. The change list requires an acceptance notice from the 교육감 or the head of NIIED, and E-2 has a change list. Keeping abroad: true plus a note is the right shape, since no engine fact can express 'hired by the MOE'. The proposed note has two problems. A move's note REPLACES the target's `how` (visamap.js howTo: main = step.note || visa.how), so as written it would hide E-2's native-speaker / 7-country text. It also needs ru, uz and uz-cyrl. The wording should also stay neutral, because for B-1 the move becomes in-Korea for DE under visit#8.
verdicts.correctedFix:
On the E-2 entries of B-1, B-2, C-3-1, C-3-4 and C-3-9 in data/visamap.yaml:
    - to: E-2
      abroad: true            # on B-1: abroadFor: b1NoChange if visit#8 is applied
      note: {en: 'Native-speaker language teacher; English teachers must be citizens of the US, UK, Canada, South Africa, New Zealand, Australia or Ireland. Usually a new visa from abroad, but teachers hired by the Ministry of Education or a provincial office of education for a primary, middle or high school (EPIK, TaLK) can change status in Korea.', ru: <translate>, uz: <translate>, uz-cyrl: <translate>}

The basis for B-1/short-term holders covers staff dispatched to install or maintain imported equipment and to supervise shipbuilding or plant fabrication. Those are D-9-2/D-9-3, which the map does not model, not trade (D-9-1). Nothing shown permits B-1/B-2/C-3-1 -> D-9-1. Adding B-2 (관광·통과) contradicts the tourism exclusion the finding itself cites. What survives is the sole-proprietor basis for D-9-4: the 2026 D-9-4 change list itself contemplates applicants who held a short-term visa before the change. Its exact 허가대상 / exclusion list could not be re-read this session.
